title: Separate example selection, context size, and display order
description:
## Scope

Represent count and token budgets separately, with deterministic token-accounting provenance and provider limits. Support nested balanced count ladders, explicit display-order seeds, and independent label-option order. Never silently truncate an oversized request.

## Definition of done

Specs show identical selected sets across display permutations, nested selections across count ladders when supported, accurate budget diagnostics, and explicit infeasible conditions.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Separate example selection, context size, and display order
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a fixed set of labeled demonstrations and two display-order seeds
    When contexts are constructed at the same budget
    Then their example membership and task wording agree while only presentation order changes
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terra implementation reviewed against the acceptance scenarios. Independent offline suite passed 144 specs. Coverage includes nested balanced random/prototype/retrieval selection, custom-policy membership and target-exclusion guards, complete request fingerprints, independent presentation order and token estimates, development-only optimization, provisional versus frozen winner, cumulative scoped call accounting, and cache-only replay. No live provider calls or dataset downloads.
